public_windows_cli.scope: Public x64 CLI execution, adjacent runtimes, existing provenance/quantity corpus and anonymous Latest metadata; no GUI, installer, physical-device or broad conformance claim.
checks: Historical and changed-page measurements remain excluded from active quantities, costs and dependent formulas.
Ordinary edits cannot reactivate historical measurements; explicit current-reference recalibration can.
Recalibration retains a compatible explicit price and typed custom fields across save/reopen.
Signed numeric CSV remains numeric; missing active totals are not fabricated zeros.
Independent PDF metadata and qpdf checks inspect the newly written copies; source hashes remain unchanged.
The downloaded CLI reports the exact release version, reads and renders a fixture with adjacent PDFium, and passes license inventory and native-loading checks.
public_windows_cli.report_publication_scope: Summary and report hashes; local filesystem paths and private fixture labels are omitted. CI artifacts remain linked in the release verification.

private_project_plan_qualification.reason: Deferred at the owner request; synthetic evidence does not establish real-project survey accuracy.

limitations: Bounded synthetic/licensed corpus and specified operations only. No universal PDF/A, PDF/UA, human accessibility or survey-accuracy claim. Windows unsigned; ARM64 has no native runtime qualification. Physical printing, physical GPU interaction and independent update authenticity remain open. A later supplementary DEB payload check matches the embedded SuniPDF CLI to both recorded conformance runs. It does not execute the payload or add runtime/desktop qualification; the desktop hash is observed only.

result.scope: Machine validation of the specified profiles and first-page appearance; human PDF/UA semantics remain unqualified.
